product_scope: itpay is the single public CLI entry point for Buyer services and the existing itpay sell Seller workflow; $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation.
title: Device Identity And Session Recovery
purpose: Explain stable local identity, official Backend-scoped registrations, Agent Type instances, and bounded automatic session recovery.
when_to_use: A different Agent window or runtime starts using an existing CLI installation.
The CLI reports device_state_unwritable, or the Backend reports agent_identity_required, agent_device_session_required, agent_device_not_found, or agent_device_revoked.
An operator confirms that the currently selected official Backend registration database was reset.

identity_model.local_key: One owner-only Ed25519 private key for the local installation.
identity_model.backend_registration: One registration per configured official Backend. Follow the current CLI backend allowlist; do not switch to evade failures.
identity_model.agent_instance: One instance per agent_type under each Backend registration; same-type windows and chats reuse it.
identity_model.presentation: Host and target route output only and never identify the Agent or provide business input.

automatic_recovery: The CLI reuses a valid cached device session.
On one HTTP 401 with code agent_device_session_required, it invalidates only the current Backend and Agent Type session, renews it, and retries the exact request once.
A second failure is returned to the Agent. The CLI does not loop, switch Agent Type, rotate the key, or create a replacement v2 device.

A new actual Agent Type proves possession of the original key to the selected Backend; the Backend resolves its original Device and idempotent Instance. Revoked Device, key or requested Instance is not replaced or reactivated.
An unknown Backend registration is re-attached once with the same key; only that Backend cache changes. The old identity file is read-only and other contexts remain intact.
A revoked v2 registration requires explicit operator recovery; it is never silently replaced.

Re-enrolling the same public key preserves the Backend Device and quota lineage after proof. internal_error is a server failure: preserve the key. Rotated/conflicting keys stop this round. This version does not support device reset-key; it returns device_key_reset_unavailable without changing identity.
local_state_recovery: The original key is retained; old identity is read-only. Each Backend/Agent Type/key fingerprint has an independent atomic session cache and generation marker. Normal authorization needs no legacy lock or process probe. Old lock files are not read, moved or deleted.
Operation idempotency uses one immutable owner-only record per operation key. Different commands and Agent processes do not share a global operation-journal lock; legacy operations.json is read only.

On device_state_unwritable, use the reported operation and errno to diagnose the failing stage without exposing local paths; keep the same Agent Type and CLI/Node launcher, restore Host-approved persistent access to ~/.itpay-v3, then retry the original command.
Do not delete a live lock, switch Node runtimes, delete identity, or rotate Agent Type as a retry strategy.

commands.success_signal: the full Skill is returned and next keeps the same Agent Type

commands.intent: confirm the selected official Backend is available
commands.success_signal: Backend liveness only; next checks auth status with the same Backend and Agent Type

commands.intent: recover after an operator-confirmed reset of the selected official Backend registration database
commands.success_signal: Only the selected Backend session caches are invalidated; key, old identity and other Backends remain

commands.intent: compatibility explanation only; not a normal recovery action
commands.success_signal: device_legacy_lock_unmanaged; old files are untouched, not repaired

agent_rules: Use the real runtime type and keep it stable across every command in the flow.
Keep the same CLI/Node launcher and Host-approved permission context for the whole flow.
Treat a new window, chat, task, or process of the same runtime as the same Agent Type, not a new identity.
Production defaults to https://app.itpay.ai; explicit sandbox or dev testing uses https://sandbox.itpay.ai or https://dev.itpay.ai. Keep the complete returned Backend-prefixed command for that flow.
After automatic recovery fails, stop and report the exact code, selected official Backend, Agent Type, and command family without exposing private keys or tokens.
forbidden: Do not delete ~/.itpay-v3, rotate the key, switch Agent Type, or repeatedly retry to obtain fresh quota.
Do not use device recover for session expiry, revocation, quota recovery, or an unconfirmed Backend failure.
Do not switch Backend to evade a failure. Allowed public URLs are app.itpay.ai, sandbox.itpay.ai and dev.itpay.ai; local loopback requires the explicit CLI development flag.
Do not use --target as identity or service input.

auth_session_states.stages: Report the actual server stage: waiting_provider (show the official handoff), email_verification_required (explicit or legacy identity verification; follow the current official page), merge_confirmation_required (the human must prove both accounts and explicitly confirm or cancel the frozen merge), provider_pending/pending (wait), completed (bind the original session and resume the same service). Ordinary login needs one verified supported identity; do not require both phone and email.
auth_session_states.terminal_states: auth_expired/auth_denied/auth_cancelled/auth_failed mean this session is over; say so plainly and respect denial or cancellation. Start a new session only on an explicit login request; never keep polling a dead one.
auth_session_states.transport_unknown: auth_status_unknown means a network error while polling — the outcome is unknown. Keep waiting on the SAME session (it may still complete); do NOT restart auth, and do not assume denial.
auth_session_states.missing: auth_session_missing means the cached session is gone. An explicit auth login opens one fresh official session in that call; auth status stays read-only.
auth_session_states.completed_resume: After login completes, execute the returned command to resume the same paused service execution. Login does not silently run that command.
auth_session_states.path_b: A buyer who reaches checkout without a login completes identity inside the protected checkout page; never force a separate itpay auth login first.
auth_session_states.identity_binding: Phone is recommended first, wallets next, email is a separate Other options choice. Extra identities are optional bindings. A phone conflict does not prove account ownership: independent target authentication and explicit human merge confirmation are required. Never use the same SMS proof twice, approve a merge for the user, or treat login/identity binding as payment consent. Service-specific contact requirements stay in the service.

key_reset_decision: This version does not support device key reset, even after an explicit decision. Preserve identity and stop; do not delete the key or install an older CLI to perform a reset.
